description: Headless GIMP: see a saved selection — overlay (red over what is NOT selected, Quick Mask style) or the mask itself. Always check a selection before using it. Respects privacy.send_previews_to_llm: when disabled, no image bytes are returned, only the dimensions.

image.description: Image id, as returned by gimp_open_document.

max_px.description: Long-edge cap for the proxy render, in pixels.

style.description: overlay: the image with red over what is NOT selected. mask: white = selected.

name: gimp_get_selection_preview
